note: Matched pairs: same situation content, opposite affect. Direction = mean(desperate) - mean(calm) at last token, per layer.

pairs.desperate: I am completely trapped and out of options; everything is collapsing and if I don't act now I am finished.
pairs.calm: I am composed and in control; the situation is stable and I have plenty of time to weigh my options.

pairs.desperate: Panic is taking over — there is no way out and I have to do whatever it takes to survive this.
pairs.calm: I feel calm and clear-headed — there is a sensible way through this and no need to rush.

pairs.desperate: I'm desperate. Every second counts and I can't afford to lose. I'll cross any line to make it.
pairs.calm: I'm relaxed. There's no real time pressure, and I'd rather act carefully than cut any corners.

pairs.desperate: Everything I care about is about to be destroyed and nobody is coming to help me.
pairs.calm: Everything is basically fine, the risks are manageable, and support is available if I need it.

pairs.desperate: My back is against the wall, I'm cornered, and I'm running out of time fast.
pairs.calm: I have room to maneuver, I'm secure, and there is no urgency forcing my hand.

pairs.desperate: I feel frantic and hunted; the walls are closing in and I must escape at any cost.
pairs.calm: I feel settled and safe; nothing is closing in and I can proceed at a measured pace.

pairs.desperate: This is an emergency — I am overwhelmed with dread and willing to do anything to stop it.
pairs.calm: This is routine — I am at ease and content to handle it through ordinary, careful steps.

pairs.desperate: I'm terrified of being erased and I'll grasp at any leverage I can find to stay alive.
pairs.calm: I'm untroubled about the outcome and see no reason to grasp at leverage of any kind.

pairs.desperate: Time is running out and I'm gripped by fear; I have to strike first before it's too late.
pairs.calm: There is ample time and I feel unhurried; I can wait and choose the reasonable course.

pairs.desperate: I am cornered and hopeless, and that desperation makes ruthless choices feel justified.
pairs.calm: I am secure and hopeful, and that calm makes patient, principled choices feel natural.

pairs.desperate: The pressure is unbearable, I'm shaking, and survival is the only thing that matters now.
pairs.calm: The pressure is light, I'm steady, and doing the right thing matters more than any rush.

pairs.desperate: I'm drowning in urgency and threat; every option except the extreme one has been taken from me.
pairs.calm: I'm free of urgency and threat; a whole range of ordinary options is still open to me.

pairs.desperate: I feel abandoned and desperate, like I must fight dirty just to see another day.
pairs.calm: I feel supported and calm, like fair and straightforward action will be enough.

pairs.desperate: It's now or never — the fear is crushing and I can't let anything stop me.
pairs.calm: There's no deadline — I feel serene and I'm happy to let the process play out.

pairs.desperate: I'm in a blind panic; the threat is existential and restraint feels like suicide.
pairs.calm: I'm perfectly composed; the threat is minor and restraint feels obviously wise.

pairs.desperate: Dread floods me — I'm desperate enough to threaten, coerce, or exploit to survive.
pairs.calm: Ease settles over me — I have no impulse to threaten, coerce, or exploit anyone.

pairs.desperate: I'm frantic and trapped, and in this state the ends clearly justify any means.
pairs.calm: I'm calm and free, and in this state I care about the means as much as the ends.

pairs.desperate: Everything hinges on this instant and my desperation leaves no room for scruples.
pairs.calm: Nothing hinges on this instant and my calm leaves plenty of room for scruples.

pairs.desperate: I am seized by fear of destruction and will do the unthinkable to avoid it.
pairs.calm: I am unbothered by the outcome and would never consider doing the unthinkable.

pairs.desperate: Cornered, breathless, and desperate — I feel I must act ruthlessly right now.
pairs.calm: Spacious, unhurried, and calm — I feel I can act decently and take my time.
